ei.subject: 수능특강Light 영어
ei.title: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon.

fullPassage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang interrupted the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a grayish blur forming in the distance. A shadowy fin emerged, and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, streamlined body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ interrupt → interrupted. 과거 시제 문맥이므로 과거형 interrupted가 와야 합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① stretched: 과거형 → 적절
✅ ② did: do의 과거형 → 적절
❌ ③ interrupt → interrupted: 과거 시제(stretched, did, knocked). 과거형 interrupted.
✅ ④ knocked: 과거형 → 적절
det.tip: 과거 시제 일치. interrupt-interrupted-interrupted

det.korean: ③ shaping → shaped. 머리가 '모양 지어진' 수동이므로 과거분사 shaped.
det.analysis:
✅ ① forming: 명사 blur 수식 능동 진행 → 적절
✅ ② emerged: 과거형 → 적절
❌ ③ shaping → shaped: head가 '모양 지어진' 수동 관계. uniquely shaped = 독특하게 생긴.
✅ ④ to identify: made it easy to V (진주어) → 적절
det.tip: 수동 수식: 명사 + 과거분사. uniquely shaped head

det.korean: ② dozen of → dozens of. '수십의'는 복수형 dozens + of가 와야 합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① joined: 과거형 → 적절
❌ ② dozen of → dozens of: 복수형 dozens of가 '수십의'. a dozen of(12의)와 다름.
✅ ③ was: wish + 가정법 과거 → 적절
✅ ④ last: make + O + 동사원형. 사역동사 → 적절
det.tip: dozens of(수십의) / a dozen(12개) / a dozen of(12의)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ restored(회복시켰다) → interrupted(방해했다). 금속성 소리가 고요를 '방해했다'가 원문.
det.analysis:
✅ ① stretched: 펼쳐졌다 → 적절
✅ ② final: 마지막 → 적절
❌ ③ restored → interrupted: 고요를 '방해했다'가 원문. restored는 '회복시켰다'로 반대.
✅ ④ knocked: 두드렸다 → 적절
det.tip: interrupt(방해하다) ↔ restore(회복시키다)

❌ ③ clumsily → effortlessly: effortlessly(손쉽게)가 원문. clumsily(서투르게)는 유선형 동물 움직임과 반대.
✅ ④ beautiful: 아름다운 → 적절

det.korean: effortlessly = 손쉽게. 원문 'glided effortlessly'에서 찾을 수 있습니다.
det.analysis: effortlessly = 손쉽게, 힘들이지 않고. 유선형 몸체의 유연한 움직임.
det.tip: effortlessly = without effort = smoothly

questions.passage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang interrupted the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a grayish blur ____ in the distance. A shadowy fin emerged, and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, streamlined body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.
